raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: dbcsr
  version: "2.10.0"
  mpi_prefix: "mpi_${{ mpi }}"

package:
  name: ${{ name }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/cp2k/dbcsr/releases/download/v${{ version }}/dbcsr-${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 3d897220fbb4498215331efad6905eb7744881b4cf04eb5c5fb4db7c48a56ef9

build:
  number: 1
  skip:
    - win
  string: ${{ mpi_prefix }}_h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ compiler('fortran') }}
    - cmake
    - make
    - fypp
    - if: build_platform != host_platform and mpi == "openmpi"
      then: ${{ mpi }}
    - if: osx
      then: llvm-openmp
  host:
    - if: linux
      then: libgomp
    - if: osx
      then: llvm-openmp
    - libblas
    - liblapack
    - ${{ mpi }}
  run_exports:
    - ${{ pin_subpackage(name, upper_bound='x.x') }}
    - ${{ name }} * ${{ mpi_prefix }}_*

tests:
  - package_contents:
      include:
        - dbcsr.h
        - dbcsr_tensor.h
      lib:
        - dbcsr
        - dbcsr_c
      files:
        - include/dbcsr_api.mod
        - include/dbcsr_tensor_api.mod
        - lib/cmake/dbcsr/DBCSRConfig.cmake
        - lib/cmake/dbcsr/DBCSRConfigVersion.cmake
        - lib/cmake/dbcsr/DBCSRTargets.cmake
        - lib/cmake/dbcsr/DBCSRTargets-release.cmake
  # Build the upstream examples against the installed package via
  # find_package(DBCSR) and run them on 2 MPI ranks
  - files:
      recipe:
        - test/
      source:
        - examples/
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ compiler('fortran') }}
        - cmake
        - make
    script:
      - export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
      - export OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT=1 OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT_CONFIRM=1
      - export OMPI_MCA_plm_ssh_agent=false OMPI_MCA_btl_sm_single_copy_mechanism=none
      - export PRTE_MCA_rmaps_default_mapping_policy=:oversubscribe
      - export HYDRA_LAUNCHER=fork
      - if: osx
        then: export OMPI_MCA_btl=self,tcp
      - cp -r examples test/
      - cmake -S test -B build -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=${PREFIX}
      - cmake --build build -j2
      - for exe in dbcsr_example_1 dbcsr_example_2 dbcsr_example_3 dbcsr_example_3_cpp; do mpiexec -n 2 ./build/${exe}; done

about:
  homepage: https://cp2k.github.io/dbcsr
  summary: DBCSR is a sparse matrix library designed to efficiently perform sparse matrix-matrix multiplication.
  description: |
    DBCSR is a sparse matrix library designed to efficiently perform sparse matrix-matrix multiplication,
    among other operations. It is MPI and OpenMP parallel, and can exploit accelerators. DBCSR was developed
    as a part of CP2K, where it provides core functionality for linear scaling electronic structure theory.
    It is now released as a standalone library for integration in other projects.
  license: GPL-2.0-or-later
  license_file: LICENSE
  repository: https://github.com/cp2k/dbcsr
  documentation: https://cp2k.github.io/dbcsr/develop/page/2-user-guide/index.html

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - martin-g
    - mkrack
